technology_name: A MAGNETORHEOLOGICAL FLUID BASED DYNAMIC VIBRATION ABSORBER SYSTEM
institution: National Institute of Technology Calicut (NIT Calicut)
technology_type: Smart Vibration Dampening / Adaptive Absorber Rig
problem_solved: Industrial precision mills and high-load production assembly frames experience variable frequency tremors that lead to mechanical tool fatigue or critical processing errors.
description: An adaptive mechanical dampening rig containing a cylindrical housing, a high-pressure gas charge chamber, an active magnetorheological (MR) fluid cavity, and a custom pistons-and-rods assembly designed to change dynamic shear limits instantly under magnetic control fields.
applications: CNC industrial milling machine stabilization arrays, high-speed automated robotic manufacturing work cells, aerospace precision instrumentation frames, and large-bore pipeline pressure pulse limiters.
